I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message to confirm the figure: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats.

I couldn't find any shared files for Marrow Agrisupply, so his message in #central-team is the only record of the seat count. Nothing else is needed. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can stay in the channel.
